notes.subject: המיות
notes.rationale: ‘Ol manmeri i save wokim nois’ (noisy multitudes, JPS/BSB) vs ‘ples bilong ol kago’ (chief place of concourse, KJV) — hapax plural of המה ‘to hum/be in tumult’.

notes.subject: אמריה תאמר
notes.rationale: Root אמר repeated: ‘ol tok bilong en em i tokaut’ — the doubling is kept partly.

translation: Long hed bilong ol manmeri i save wokim planti nois em i singaut, long ol ples bilong go insait long ol dua bilong banis, long taun em i tokaut ol tok bilong en:

tokens.gloss: bilong ol manmeri i save wokim planti nois
long ol ples bilong go insait
